Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-elss-tax-saver-fund-direct-plan-growth.
Fund manager: Amar Kalkundrikar.
Fund managers: Amar Kalkundrikar (managing since Dec 2025), Dhruv Muchhal (managing since Jun 2023).

Exit load: Nil (lock-in period applies).

Riskometer classification: Very High Risk.
Benchmark index: NIFTY 500 Total Return Index.
Latest NAV: Rs. 1,516.49. (as of 25 Aug 2026).
Fund size (AUM): Rs. 16,095.45 Cr.
